steps: Log into your WordPress admin dashboard (usually /your-site.com/wp-admin)
If you have Yoast SEO: Go to SEO -> Search Appearance -> General. If not, go to Settings -> General.
Locate the 'Tagline' or 'Meta Description' field.
Paste the recommended text below.
Click 'Save Changes'.

steps: Log into your Squarespace account and open your site.
Click on 'Marketing' in the left-hand panel, then click 'SEO'.
Scroll to the 'Site Meta Description' field.
Paste the recommended text below.
Click 'Save' at the top left.
squarespace.exact_text: Looking for the best [CATEGORY] in [CITY]? [BUSINESS NAME] offers [PRIMARY_SERVICE]. [BENEFIT]. Book online today!

steps: Go to your Wix Dashboard and click 'Marketing & SEO'.
Select 'SEO Tools' then 'SEO Settings'.
Click on 'Main Pages' and find your Home page.
Edit the 'Meta Description' field with the text below.
Click 'Save' and 'Publish' to make it live.
wix.exact_text: Looking for the best [CATEGORY] in [CITY]? [BUSINESS NAME] offers [PRIMARY_SERVICE]. [BENEFIT]. Book online today!

steps: Log into your Shopify Admin.
Go to 'Online Store' -> 'Preferences'.
Find the 'Homepage meta description' box.
Enter the recommended description below.
Click 'Save' at the top or bottom of the page.
shopify.exact_text: Looking for the best [CATEGORY] in [CITY]? [BUSINESS NAME] offers [PRIMARY_SERVICE]. [BENEFIT]. Book online today!

steps: Log into WordPress.
Go to Settings -> General.
Update the 'Site Title' field. (Note: If using Yoast/RankMath, update it in the SEO plugin settings for the Homepage instead).
Click 'Save Changes'.
Open Squarespace and go to 'Marketing' -> 'SEO'.
Find 'Title Appearance' and click on 'Home'.
Edit the 'SEO Title Format' to match the text below.
Click 'Save'.
Go to Wix Dashboard -> Marketing & SEO -> SEO Tools.
Select 'SEO Settings' -> 'Main Pages'.
Click on the Home page and edit the 'Page Title' field.
Save and Publish.
Go to Shopify Admin -> Online Store -> Preferences.
Update the 'Homepage title' field.
Click 'Save'.
Go to 'Pages' and click 'Edit' on your Home page.
Locate the main heading at the very top (the title of the page).
Change it to the recommended text below.
Ensure the block type is set to 'Heading 1' (H1).
Click 'Update'.
Open your Home page and click 'Edit'.
Click into the main text block at the top of the page.
Highlight the text and select 'Heading 1' from the format menu.
Type the recommended text below.
Click 'Done' -> 'Save'.
Open the Wix Editor.
Double-click your main homepage headline.
In the 'Text Settings' panel, ensure 'Themes' is set to 'Heading 1'.
Update the text to match our recommendation.
Click 'Publish'.
Install the 'WP Rocket' or 'W3 Total Cache' plugin.
Go to TinyPNG.com and compress all your homepage images before re-uploading.
Use the 'WebP Express' plugin to serve images in modern formats.
Remove any unused plugins (aim for under 15 total).
Uninstall any apps you are not using (each app adds scripts that slow down your site).
Ensure your images are 'Lazy Loaded' (standard in most modern Shopify themes).
Use an app like 'Avada SEO' to automatically compress images.
Image Compression: Large images are the #1 cause of slow sites. Use TinyPNG.com.
Modern Formats: Use WebP instead of heavy PNG or JPEG files.
Reduce Scripts: Disable any unnecessary tracking codes or heavy video backgrounds.
general.exact_text: A 1-second delay in load time can reduce conversions by 7%.

steps: Login to business.google.com.
Select 'Edit Profile' -> 'Business Information'.
Update 'Description': Use the text provided below.
Update 'Category': Set your Primary Category to '[CATEGORY]'.
Add Photos: Upload 5 high-res photos of your work.
Ask for Reviews: Use the Review Request template in your content library.
google.exact_text: [BUSINESS NAME] is the premier [CATEGORY] in [CITY]. We specialize in [PRIMARY_SERVICE] with a focus on [BENEFIT]. Trusted by locals for years. Call us today!

steps: Contact your hosting provider (GoDaddy, Bluehost, etc.) and ask them to 'Enable Auto-SSL'.
If you are on Squarespace/Wix/Shopify, SSL is included—go to Settings -> Domains and ensure 'Secure' is checked.
Force HTTPS: Ensure your site redirects from http to https.
all_platforms.exact_text: Your connection must be secure to build trust and prevent Chrome warnings.

steps: WordPress: Install Yoast SEO; your sitemap is at yoursite.com/sitemap_index.xml.
Squarespace/Wix/Shopify: Sitemaps are automatic at yoursite.com/sitemap.xml.
Submit to Google: Go to Google Search Console -> Sitemaps and paste your sitemap URL.
all_platforms.exact_text: Ensures Google can find and index every page of your site.

Upload your logo image.

steps: Primary Button: Ensure your 'Book Now' or 'Get Quote' button is a bright, contrasting color.
Above the Fold: Your main CTA must be visible without scrolling.
Phone Number: Add your phone number to the top right of your header.
Limit Choices: Don't give users 5 different buttons. Tell them exactly what to do next.
general.exact_text: Your website's only job is to get a lead. Make it easy for them.

steps: Increase Word Count: Add 300-500 words of helpful content to your homepage.
Better H1: Make your H1 tag more specific (City + Service) than your competitors.
Local Citations: Ensure your Name, Address, and Phone (NAP) are identical on Yelp, Bing, and Facebook.
general.exact_text: The goal is to provide more 'Local Signals' than the businesses outranking you.
